name: This Bond We Share
source:
This Bond We Share is a romance/psychological horror mod where you will see through the eyes of MC and Yuri as they both struggle with their obsessive and sometimes violent tendencies.

[Edited from [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DDLCMods/comments/1j6ngrd/comment/mgq0i3v/]Reddit[/url]]
translation:
《This Bond We Share》是一款浪漫/心理恐怖模组，你将通过MC和尤里的眼睛看到他们都在与自己的强迫症和有时是暴力倾向作斗争。

[编辑自[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DDLCMods/comments/1j6ngrd/comment/mgq0i3v/]Reddit[/url]]
